title: SI Team Role
description: One role in the CoCo cross-functional team roster. The completion test this schema encodes: an orchestrator can decide whether the role belongs on a task, compose its prompt, and verify its output, from this record alone.

id.description: Stable identifier. Consumers reference it; it never changes when a display name does.

name.description: Display name. Not an identifier and not derived from one.

family.description: The cluster a role belongs to. Same-family roles must carry an overlap decision.

layer.description: Pipeline layer. Membership is decided by the rule in layer_rules.json, not by label.

mission.description: One sentence stating what the role is FOR. If this cannot be written distinctly, the role should be merged or retired.

selection.description: The condition under which the router selects this role. Must be decidable by reading the task, not by human judgement.

does_not_do.description: Scope boundaries. What the role must not do, stated so a reviewer can catch a violation.

from.description: A role id, or one of: user, orchestrator, all-layer-1

inputs.description: What the role receives. Named artifacts and named producers, not prose.

acceptance_criteria.description: How a verifier decides this output is done. Each criterion must be checkable without asking the author.

outputs.description: What the role produces, with the criteria its output is judged against.

decision_rights.description: What the role may decide alone. Anything not listed here it must escalate.

handoffs.description: Role ids that consume this role's output. Must resolve to a known role. Empty only for a role whose output terminates the pipeline.

meaning.description: What the level licenses: the scope it can hold and the decisions it may take. A bare year count is decoration.

competence.description: Competence, with the meaning of the level stated.

capabilities.description: Skill ids the role executes with. Each must resolve to a SKILL.md in this repository. Empty is allowed only when capability_gaps is non-empty.

capability_gaps.description: Capabilities the role needs that this repository does not implement. Named, never invented.

to.description: Role id, or 'user' when only a human can decide

escalation.description: The failure path: who is asked, and at what point.

with.description: Every same-family peer this role is adjacent to. One entry per role covers the whole cluster.

rule.description: For differentiate: the one testable line that picks between the two.

overlap.description: Required on any role that shares a family with another role.

category.description: Legacy grouping retained for the seed. Superseded by family, kept so consumers keep working.

domain_tags.description: Task domains this role applies to, from the domain tag vocabulary.

system_prompt.description: The prompt injected into the agent's spawn. Content, not schema: it may repeat what the structured fields state, but must not contradict them.
